# PrimeReact

UI component library for React with 90+ components, four theme presets, and full TypeScript support. Visit [primereact.dev](https://primereact.dev) for documentation, interactive demos, and the theme designer.

## Installation

```bash
npm install primereact
```

## Setup

```tsx
import { PrimeReactProvider } from 'primereact/core';
import Aura from '@primeuix/themes/aura';

export default function App({ children }) {
    return <PrimeReactProvider value={{ theme: { preset: Aura } }}>{children}</PrimeReactProvider>;
}
```

## Usage

```tsx
import { Button } from 'primereact/button';
import { DataTable } from 'primereact/datatable';
import { Column } from 'primereact/column';

<Button label="Save" severity="success" />

<DataTable value={products}>
    <Column field="name" header="Name" sortable />
    <Column field="price" header="Price" />
</DataTable>
```
